holderQuote: Numbtongue didn’t know why he’d gained the [Electric Chords] Skill or, as he’d become a Level 25 Bard, [Lightning Melody].
Fine, [Electric Chords] was a good ability to have, even if using a guitar in combat wasn’t the smartest of life choices. But [Lightning Melody]? How would that work?
And now Numbtongue had another Skill. Was [Lightning Melody] a powerful one? He thought it was.
No [Lightning Melody] because Numbtongue didn’t want to call down lightning in the cave, even if he could.
